rationale: PINS the G3 gap: Foo.bar method values (Foo::bar's scala form) reference the type Foo. Scala parses Foo.bar as a field_expression whose receiver is a capitalized identifier — a type-qualified member handle, exactly like the kotlin callable_reference finding. The receiver-only rule: capitalized receiver = type reference (G3); lowercase receiver = receiver use (G8, field-uses fixture). Call positions (xs.map) are skipped — the call edge carries them.

forbidRelationships.comment: M37 TSD6-sweep: call-position field_expression must never double-emit as a method_value reference (dead `=== n` skip class)
